summary: Section Review A. The audit covered Phase 2 of track storytime_cover_options_20261106 at audited_head_sha 6cceee91. Guard G-1 holds: every code and test commit of the track in the range e6e2156a..6cceee91 touches only the five scope files. The template module, the build script, the data file, and both test files match the spec and the pins P1 to P12. The test lists T01 to T30 and B01 to B14 plus B07b are complete, and each test asserts the behavior it names. The QR fix of commit d65955fe reads the QR box and fails a page with no box. Every capture claim matches the files: 227 tests of the two files, 1808 project tests, 22 and 23 mutants caught, 32 pages and 44 files of the dry build. No test run was performed, per the load rule of 2026-11-08. The verdict is pass with no blocker and no major. Three latent findings are nonblocking: one Minor and two Nit.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Minor] review-a: The build script function unitPanelValues catches every error and returns an empty list. A week file or phonics graph read failure renders the student back with an empty panel. Every build report check (copy, thai, qr, pageSize, ppi, band, forbidden) still passes, because checkQuestCopy checks only the series name, the forbidden words, and the year. Latent: the shipped build fills the panel, so no page changed at HEAD. Location: dashboard/scripts/storytime/make-storytime-quest-covers.ts:913. Fix: return an error instead of an empty list, or fail the build when the student back panel is empty.

F2 [Nit] review-a: checkQuestArt coerces a bleed value other than 3 to 0 instead of reporting an error. Pin P10 says a bleed other than 0 or 3 is an error. The live path is safe: the build hardcodes a bleed of 0, and questPageSize and checkQuestPageSize report the error, which test T08 covers. Latent only. Location: dashboard/lib/storytime/print/cover-quest.ts:691. Fix: push an error when the bleed is not 0 or 3.

F3 [Nit] review-a: The leaf band glyph SVG container ends 4.5 mm from the trim edge, inside the 5 mm safe zone by box measure. The ink ends about 5.2 mm from the trim, so decision D-A5 holds for the ink. T09 checks only QUEST_BOXES parts, so this inline SVG has no safe zone check. Location: dashboard/lib/storytime/print/cover-quest.ts:1245. Fix: add the band glyph box to QUEST_BOXES, or extend T09 to the inline SVG.
